1. Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)O)cc2)cc1 (a sulfonyl‑aryl‑cinnamic acid)  
2. Nc1ccccc1N (a diamino‑benzene).  

The next step is to apply template 1914396 to the first precursor (the sulfonyl‑aryl‑cinnamic acid) to disconnect the sulfonyl‑aryl bond. Then we will apply template 733 to the resulting fragments to reach simple, commercially available building blocks.
